Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
Couple of things came up this week that I'd like to ask:

Does Goratrix's special ability work on Allies?

Methuselah A has Sanguinus Instruction on a Ventrue, which Clan
Impersonated into a Daughter of Cacophony, giving that minion inferior
Melpominee. Methuselah A then gives that Sanguinus Instruction to
another Methuselah's vampire through a Succubus club. Does the new
minion now have inferior Melpominee?

Can a minion play Soul Stealing if they are going to torpor
themselves?

Which would you classify as a 'Nutpuncher' deck; a deck that has 5
disciplines, or a deck that has no hope of ousting it's prey by itself
except if the prey laughs so hard they don't notice you pushing their
pool into the blood bank?

And finally, if one were to go to sleep during the second round of a
sanctioned V:EKN tournament, having notified the judge of said nap, do
they take a loss or are they omitted from that round. Said individual
went on to play the 3rd round and receive a game win.

Ethan Burrow - Prince of Austin
saa...@yahoo.com
http://whitestar.ddg.com/vtes/

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3c47c756...@news-server.austin.rr.com>, Ethan Burrow

<saa...@yahoo.com> writes:
>Couple of things came up this week that I'd like to ask:
>
>Does Goratrix's special ability work on Allies?

Yes. You can steal blood from allies (e.g. Theft of Vitae). They lose
life instead.

See [6.4.5] and the example. (Stealing blood from an ally.)

>Methuselah A has Sanguinus Instruction on a Ventrue, which Clan
>Impersonated into a Daughter of Cacophony, giving that minion inferior
>Melpominee. Methuselah A then gives that Sanguinus Instruction to
>another Methuselah's vampire through a Succubus club. Does the new
>minion now have inferior Melpominee?

That wouldn't happen.

This is analogous to [LSJ 20010719]

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3B601F1C%40MailAndNews.com&rnum=6

"Trading a master card on a minion via the Succubus Club won't move the
Master Card - it just changes control."

>Can a minion play Soul Stealing if they are going to torpor
>themselves?

At superior, sure. The only thing that stops (say) Taste of Vitae being
played then is card text.

>Which would you classify as a 'Nutpuncher' deck; a deck that has 5
>disciplines, or a deck that has no hope of ousting it's prey by itself
>except if the prey laughs so hard they don't notice you pushing their
>pool into the blood bank?

I believe that should go to Derek Ray.

>And finally, if one were to go to sleep during the second round of a
>sanctioned V:EKN tournament, having notified the judge of said nap, do
>they take a loss or are they omitted from that round. Said individual
>went on to play the 3rd round and receive a game win.

*giggle*

Unfortunately, I fear this would be covered under 3.3 (Tardiness) - 15
minutes delay and you get a loss and an ejection.
